title: The Most Reasonable Explanation (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry observational comedy spoken word 128bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan male vocal absurdist logic dry wit cabaret
lyrics:
[Intro - dry piano, measured pace]
Now I'm a reasonable man
I approach these things methodically
And when I see something unusual
I work through it logically

[Verse 1]
My neighbour's fence was fine last Tuesday
I checked it from the kitchen window, yes
By Thursday morning it had fallen
And I must say I was not impressed

Now some men would just say wind did it
Some men would say the timber gave
But I don't accept the obvious answer
Until I have examined every available explanation

[Pre-Chorus]
So I sat down with a cup of tea
And I thought this through from start to end
I considered wind, I considered rain
I considered the structural integrity of the bend

And I arrived at a conclusion
It took some time but I got there in the end

[Chorus]
The most reasonable explanation
After careful and deliberate thought
Is that something of considerable determination
Pushed that fence down from the other side
The most reasonable explanation
Is not the one that first appears
Sometimes the answer requires patience
And approximately four to six years

[Verse 2]
I documented all my findings
In a folder, labelled clearly in red
I presented them to my neighbour Margaret
She looked at me for a while and then she said
Have you considered that I reversed my car into it
On Wednesday evening around half past ten

[Bridge - spoken, completely unfazed]
Yes
I had considered that
I ruled it out
Too obvious
The most reasonable explanation
Is rarely that straightforward

[Chorus]
The most reasonable explanation
After careful and deliberate thought
Is that something of considerable determination
Pushed that fence down from the other side
The most reasonable explanation
Is not the one that first appears
Sometimes the answer requires patience
And approximately four to six years

[Outro - piano resolves with mild satisfaction]
Margaret put the fence back up
On Friday, using her own tools
And I noted in my documentation
That this was consistent with my findings all along
The most reasonable explanation
Was confirmed
